name: Jish's First Person Mod
author: Jish
description: Custom glance controls, right-stick look on foot, smoother board transitions and first-person comfort options. Compatibility test for the exact official ReSkate 2.1.0 release. Stock owns controller menu navigation; this panel uses mouse and keyboard. Press Insert for settings and the recommended preset. Enable or disable here before starting the game. Requires the included scripts folder.
